versions.content: Topology Type: valid Description: The System Template has to describe the topology of an EE System. Rationale: The available communication paths limit the possible distributions of SW Components to some ECUs. Dependencies: None identified. Use Case: Mapping of SW Components being tightly linked from a functional point of view: the topology must then be known in order to avoid too long data paths. Supporting Material: –
